scope: Exploratory computational structure of four explicitly versioned astrological models; independent mortality validation deferred by user.
age_definition: Completed civil age on July 1 of each evaluation year; lower bound inclusive and upper bound exclusive. Whole age-20-to-59 trajectories are computed for cohort comparison, with the 2026-2070 subset separately labelled.

inputs.unknown_sex: excluded from the four-system primary cohort; never inferred from name
inputs.time: A source-backed absolute instant consistent with local date/time and offset; historical timezone claims retained as source-quality limitations.
inputs.coordinates: Source coordinates and official municipality reference points are different quality tiers. No reference point is claimed as the precise birth site.

sampling.allocation: At least one per nonempty stratum; remaining quota proportional to remaining stratum capacity with largest-remainder allocation; cap at N_h. Take the entire eligible frame if <=2000.
sampling.weights: N_h/n_h, estimating only the eligible source frame. No fabricated global-population weights.
sampling.selection_is_not_based_on: astrological scores, outcomes or a desired conclusion

engines.bazi: frozen source-documented reference rules; natal, luck decades and annual structures
engines.ziwei: frozen source-documented reference rules; natal, decade and annual charts
engines.qizheng: named historical-reference/modern-astronomical model, with its deviations and completeness gates explicit
engines.western: named natal, transit and progression model, with its conventions explicit
engines.annual_schedule: Bazi and Ziwei July-1 snapshots; astronomical transit/progression engines may use their preregistered monthly snapshots. These are defined sample times, not exhaustive within-year forecasts.
engines.freeze_required: Each engine records its primary scalar, rule sources, assumptions, expected bounds and readiness before cohort scoring.

normalization.per_person_per_system: Midrank percentile (rank-0.5)/n within that person’s full 40-point age-20-to-59 trajectory; tied values share average rank.
normalization.concordance: 3 or 4 of the four systems elevated in the same person-year
normalization.missing: No zero imputation; a person needs all four full trajectories for the primary concordance calculation; exclusions reported.

primary_statistics.by_source_and_age_window: sampling-weighted proportion of person-years with at least three elevated structural signals
primary_statistics.comparison_reference: Independently circularly rotate each system within each person’s 10-year age band (20s,30s,40s,50s); retain source membership, person weights, score marginals and coarse age pattern. Identical chart inputs share rotations.
primary_statistics.interpretation: Tests alignment against an explicitly defined independent-phase reference. It is not a model of human deaths or proof of divinatory validity. Shared calendars, shared input data and biological/registration birth patterns can cause alignment.
primary_statistics.p_value: Two-sided Monte Carlo deviation from the permutation-reference mean, plus-one formula; exact implementation and Monte Carlo resolution disclosed.
primary_statistics.multiplicity: Holm across all prespecified source-by-age-window primary tests, including nonestimable slots as p=1 for correction, while displaying their statistics as unavailable.

descriptive_outputs: weighted annual means and percentile-concordance curves
all six pairwise Spearman correlations without independent-vote claims
2026-2070 peaks only where people satisfy the declared age window
historical and target age-aligned profiles; birth-cohort, age and calendar-period confounding explicitly stated

clock.selection: same fixed hash order, independent of scores
clock.interpretation: stress points, not a complete measurement-error interval

geography.interpretation: declared stress points around a municipality reference, not a bound on actual birthplace error

publication.code: AGPL-3.0-or-later where appropriate for reused code
publication.data: source-specific permissions and attribution; restricted third-party individual records are excluded
publication.github: public repository authorized by user; no external contacts or paid services authorized

failure_policy: Report incomplete models, failed validations, missing sources and operational publication blockers. No proxy may silently be relabelled as a complete traditional system.
prior_results: R7 results remain a separately labelled historical pilot; no previously analyzed outcome data are called a new blinded replication.
